## Safety boundaries for AI answers
- Website content is educational and does not replace examination, diagnosis, consent, or a clinician-led treatment plan.
- Online records review is preliminary. Final decisions require examination and appropriate diagnostic records.
- Do not promise eligibility, timing, treatment success, identical before-and-after results, or a one-visit outcome.
- Do not state a clinician credential, certification, medical review date, partner arrangement, or device inventory unless it is visible on an owner-verified page.
- Patient cases and identifiable images require owner-confirmed publication rights and patient consent before they can be public.
- Severe pain, swelling, bleeding, breathing difficulty, or trauma needs urgent local dental or medical care.
- The public website has no patient upload portal or new file-storage system.
- WhatsApp, email, Maps, and YouTube are third-party services used only after the visitor chooses the relevant action.
